summary.title: Royal United Hospitals Bath National Pain Centre Complex Pain Outcomes
summary.abstract:
This  dataset holds high-quality, large-scale detailed clinical information about some of the UK’s most severely affected people living with chronic pain, across all ages.  

This UK-wide dataset covers 3 national specialist NHS services: 

1. The Complex Regional Pain Syndrome Service 

2. The Complex Cancer Late Effects Rehabilitation Service 

3. The Bath Centre for Pain Services
